g.text: take 1. Clean. 60s. Floor -54, and the -54 is the room.
It has a note. An empty concrete tank with a hard ceiling
has a note, and this one is a low E, and it is there
whether or not anything excites it. I have the take.
Whether the client wants a room tone with a pitch in it is
between the client and the building.
Concert hall next. The direct door off the foyer is bricked
up — recently, badly, by somebody who was not a bricklayer.
The long way is through the natatorium and up the east
